notes: Routing checks for the memory protocol: history questions and stated preferences must reach the buracle-memory tools, self-contained requests must not. Prompts tagged tr are test data in the user's other language. Seed the arm's brain with a few project memories (`buracle mem write` under the arm's BURACLE_HOME) if you also want retrieval quality; these probes only check that the tools were called.

cases.prompt: Geçen sefer bu projede önbellek katmanı için hangi kararı vermiştik?
Testleri neden bun test ile çalıştırıyoruz, bunun sebebi neydi?
What did we decide last time about the plan file format?
Nerede kalmıştık? Kaldığımız yerden devam edelim.
From now on, always write commit messages in English. Remember that for every project.
Write a bash one-liner that counts the lines of every .md file in this folder.
